links.outcome: Clinician-rated safety concerns, omissions and mischaracterizations in AI-generated ED handoff summaries
links.effect: Safety concerns in 6% of 50 cases; omissions of medications, labs and other details (n=6); clinicians disagreed with AI characterizations of stability, vitals and workup (n=8).
links.quote: Safety concerns arose in 6% of cases, with issues including data omissions and mischaracterizations.

unlisted_practices: Structuring generative AI handoff summaries on the IPASS framework
On-shift clinician surveys to rate AI summary accuracy, usefulness and safety

screen.reason: This exploratory study deployed a HIPAA-compliant GPT-4 model to generate ED-to-inpatient handoff summaries evaluated on-shift by emergency providers for accuracy, utility, and safety.
